climb.convention: gallons for the climb phase — the rate beside it is climb_gph

climb_gph.convention: the plan's own climb rate, seeded from the aircraft profile's climb_gph and written by the pilot; every leg up to the TOC burns at it

cruise.convention: gallons for the cruise phase — the rate beside it is cruise_gph

cruise_gph.convention: the plan's own cruise rate, seeded from the aircraft profile's cruise_gph and written by the pilot; every leg after the TOC burns at it

dev.convention: added to magnetic; compass heading = magnetic heading + deviation

eta.convention: the cell's own text: elapsed time written like an ete ("1h20") when no departure time is set, a clock time ("15:20Z") when one is. The figures behind it are `arrivals` in GET /plans/{id}/render

ete.convention: a duration as text: m:ss under an hour, held to ten seconds ("4:40"); HhMM from an hour ("1h20"). A colon is always minutes:seconds, and a bare number written to the API is minutes

fuel_burn.convention: gallons burned on this leg, not a rate

reserves_gph.convention: the rate the reserve is counted at — cruise_gph unless the pilot says otherwise

reserves_minutes.convention: minutes of reserve to hold back; 45 unless the whole flight lands in daylight

var.convention: positive is WEST; magnetic heading = true heading + variation. Note this is the opposite of the WMM/IGRF convention, which is positive east

wca.convention: positive turns right; true heading = true course + wca

wind_dir.convention: degrees TRUE, and the direction the wind blows FROM
